motion.name: tab
motion.purpose: Opacity when a tab opens. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: tab-indicator
motion.purpose: The signal rectangle behind the active tab. Snaps under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Portrait
components.description: Round night portrait overlapping the Riyadh plate. 8.75rem, 11rem from 640px, 13rem from 1024px, 6.75rem on a phone.

components.name: Tab
components.description: Text tab. Inactive tabs are cyan. The selected tab is ice type in a signal rectangle with a 0.375rem radius that slides between tabs.

components.name: Glass panel
components.description: Frosted ice panel that holds the page, over the cyan-band gutters with contours and floating shapes.

keyCharacteristics: ice glass panel over cyan-band gutters, ink type, cyan secondary, signal red on the marks
geist serif for the name and sentences, host grotesk for tabs, meta and panel titles
one panel, left aligned text, centred titles and short rows

rules.name: One panel
rules.body: The plate, the portrait, the statement, and the lists share the glass panel width.

rules.name: Lowercase
rules.body: Visible copy is lowercase. Meta tags and JSON-LD keep case.
